candidate_principles.principle: Represent continuous soft contact by a recursively adapted, decision-sufficient action-conditional operator. At every update, classify the pre-outcome context-action pair as supported, unsupported-but-inside the adaptation envelope, or outside that envelope but inside the declared withdrawal envelope. Supported scan actions use calibrated margins; adapting scan actions must belong to an independently valid envelope-feasible set and posterior belief may only further restrict them or shape their objective; outside-envelope states return a preverified withdrawal impedance/reference action in constant time. The remaining scan-mode decision is rendered by incumbent persistence or viability. In SUPPORTED or ADAPTING scan mode, totality is realized by verified-incumbent persistence; OUTSIDE-ENVELOPE returns u_wd directly.
activation_conditions: A material, local geometry, sliding condition, speed, dwell or loading-history change inside the declared physical envelope changes the predicted contact margin or preferred feasible impedance.
A pre-outcome support score or sequential residual audit makes the initial calibrated relation inapplicable, while at least one action remains admissible under the envelope-conservative relation.
The optimizer faces active physical or computation constraints and must return an applied gain at every declared update.
candidate_principles.intervention: Construct and adapt the support-aware predictive contact operator. In SUPPORTED scan mode verify RTI-SQP candidates in F_cal; in ADAPTING scan mode verify them in F_adapt, which is always a subset of F_env. Atomically replace the shifted incumbent only after verification, otherwise return it. OUTSIDE-ENVELOPE bypasses the optimizer and returns the preverified withdrawal tuple u_wd before the same deadline.
candidate_principles.changed_structure: NNBO fixed scalar preidentified contact law -> history- and action-conditioned predictive contact operator with explicit support state -> active in-envelope adaptation under a valid envelope relation -> posterior-aware constrained normal-tangential impedance selection -> one of two explicit totality mechanisms.
candidate_principles.root_cause_resolution_rationale: The contact operator preserves exactly the history information that changes feasible impedance or its ranking. During calibration-out adaptation, F_adapt is constructed so F_adapt is a subset of F_env by definition; posterior belief can veto actions or shape objective/information value but cannot relax F_env before audited re-entry. Leaving the adaptation envelope activates a controller-internal withdrawal branch with a preverified dissipative gain/reference action and constant-time lookup. Thus all three support states produce an applied action while arbitrary-shift performance or safety is not claimed. The scan-mode totality mechanism remains open between incumbent persistence and viability certification.
failure_conditions: The observation history does not distinguish decision-relevant contact aliases before a gain change is needed.
The declared adaptation envelope does not imply a nonempty conservative scan relation for the current unsupported regime.
No admissible impedance variation provides enough excitation to adapt before the regime changes again.
A delayed locally stationary calibration buffer cannot be formed, so calibrated re-entry is unavailable and only envelope-conservative operation remains claimable.
The four-gain contact-frame action class cannot achieve the required joint performance.
The selected scan-mode totality mechanism cannot return an admissible action by the update deadline.
The preverified withdrawal action is infeasible, late, or fails to monotonically unload within the declared withdrawal envelope.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: A compact action-observation history state predicts every future outcome and margin needed to preserve impedance feasibility and ranking over the declared action class.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: The representation must expand or the claim envelope must narrow; otherwise contact histories remain decision-aliased.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: For every unsupported-but-in-envelope state, declared physics, actuator bounds and contact-retention limits define a nonempty conservative margin relation independently of the adaptive posterior.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: The method cannot continue adaptation safely in that state and must narrow the envelope or stop.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: In-envelope changes are locally learnable from natural or margin-feasible information actions before their decision relevance expires.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: The method can remain conservative but cannot claim online recovery of useful optimal impedance.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: After adaptation, a delayed, non-overlapping residual buffer can satisfy the declared local-stationarity and dependence conditions needed for the predeclared empirical calibration audit.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: Posterior decision recovery may be observed, but calibrated-margin re-entry cannot be claimed.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: Every state admitted to the OUTSIDE-ADAPTATION-ENVELOPE branch remains inside a separately declared withdrawal envelope in which a preverified dissipative impedance and normal-unload reference are robot-side feasible, rate compliant, and retrievable before the same update deadline.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: The three-state applied-action relation is not total; the claim envelope must narrow or a lower-level certified emergency relation is required.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: A current verified incumbent exists and its shifted sequence remains admissible or can be conservatively repaired before the deadline as the contact state and margin authority change.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: The incumbent branch loses totality even if the adaptive contact operator is valid.

target_domain_operationalization: Use the instantaneous contact frame and a minimal action a_k=(k_n,d_n,k_t,d_t). The observation y_k contains pose, indentation and velocity, six-axis wrench, scan tangent/normal, slip/contact indicators, previous gain and interaction-energy ledger; z_k=E(y_0:k,a_0:k-1) is a predictive state, not a material label.

The operator predicts an H-step posterior over normal-force error, tangential trajectory error, contact retention, slip/friction capacity, wrench, interaction energy and actuator load conditional on a candidate impedance sequence.

Offline training combines multistep predictive likelihood with feasible-set disagreement and constrained decision regret relative to a higher-information teacher. Nested-state pruning removes features whose omission does not change the declared feasible set or impedance ranking.

At each update, a pre-outcome applicability map S_k(z,a) classifies each candidate pair. SUPPORTED means the pair lies in the declared calibration population and passes the support audit; ADAPTING-IN-ENVELOPE means initial calibration is inapplicable but the pair lies in the adaptation envelope; OUTSIDE-ENVELOPE means scan adaptation is no longer defensible but the measured robot/contact state remains inside a separately declared withdrawal envelope.

For SUPPORTED pairs, the optimizer consumes calibrated one-sided margins M_cal. For ADAPTING-IN-ENVELOPE pairs define F_env={a:g_env,j(z,a,w)>=0 for every j and every w in W_env}. Then F_adapt=F_env intersect F_veto, with F_veto determined by posterior lower margins only when it is nonempty and contains the declared fallback; otherwise F_veto is the whole action set. Therefore F_adapt is always a subset of F_env. The posterior may add restrictions or shape cost/information value, but can never shrink W_env or relax any g_env constraint. Covariance inflation is never called coverage.

The frozen representation backbone feeds a low-dimensional Bayesian/RLS readout. Every observed outcome updates its mean and covariance; persistent normalized innovation increases forgetting and covariance. If uncertainty can change an active margin or gain ranking, the optimizer may choose an information-bearing impedance only from the current valid admissible relation.

Re-entry from ADAPTING-IN-ENVELOPE to SUPPORTED requires a delayed residual buffer not reused for the readout update, a predeclared effective sample size, a local-stationarity/dependence check and success of the empirical one-sided calibration audit. Until then the envelope relation remains authoritative even if posterior prediction or decision regret improves.

The horizon objective minimizes expected normal-force and tangential tracking loss, contact-loss/slip risk and gain variation, with a bounded information-value term only for decision-relevant uncertainty. It imposes the current-state margins on wrench, contact/friction, interaction energy, actuator effort and gain magnitude/rate.

OUTSIDE-ENVELOPE bypasses scan optimization in the same update and returns the preverified withdrawal tuple u_wd=(WITHDRAW,a_wd,r_wd): tangential reference speed goes to zero, gains move within rate bounds to a dissipative withdrawal setting, and the normal reference unloads along the last verified normal until the measured contact force is below the release threshold. u_wd is a constant-time lookup checked against robot-side wrench, energy, actuator and gain-rate bounds within the declared withdrawal envelope. No adaptation performance or arbitrary-shift safety claim is made in this branch.

In SUPPORTED or ADAPTING scan mode, initialize from a feasible sequence and publish a replacement only after complete verification in F_cal or F_adapt. Timeout returns the incumbent. OUTSIDE-ENVELOPE has priority over incumbent logic and returns u_wd by constant-time lookup; a feasibility-restoration solve never certifies totality by itself.

target_intervention_novelty.uncovered_residual_delta: NNBO acts after trial-fixed scalar Hunt-Crossley identification and leaves abrupt/time-varying parameters open. MPVIC couples a probabilistic ensemble to uncertainty-seeking offline data acquisition and a separate deployment stiffness MPC in unconstrained free-space tasks; it does not establish continual soft-contact readout adaptation, state-dependent valid margins or admissible online information actions. The remaining Target delta is the adaptive decision-sufficient contact operator with explicit support-state semantics, constrained normal-tangential selection and a total applied-action relation.
target_intervention_novelty.mechanism_delta: At the causal position before gain selection, replace fixed scalar contact parameters with a history/action posterior; on pre-outcome support loss inside the envelope, switch margin authority from population calibration to an independently conservative envelope relation, adapt using only actions admissible under that relation, and require a delayed audit before calibrated re-entry.
target_intervention_novelty.scientific_delta: Determine whether this support-aware active contact adaptation recovers useful constrained normal-tangential impedance decisions under calibration-out changes, while preserving explicit failure boundaries and one total applied action.

candidate_principles.provisional_scientific_delta: A support-state-aware adaptive decision-sufficient contact operator that converts calibration-out soft-contact changes into constrained impedance decision recovery rather than detection or refusal, paired with one of two still-competing totality mechanisms. Variant A adds interruption-safe verified-incumbent persistence without making the optimizer itself the paper headline.
candidate_principles.substantive_difference: Relative to NNBO, the modeled object, update timing and optimizer all change: fixed scalar material parameters become a history/action posterior over joint outcomes and margins; pre-identification becomes continual local adaptation with explicit margin-authority states; and unconstrained scalar optimal control becomes constrained belief-space selection of normal/tangential stiffness and damping. Incumbent and viability mechanisms remain subordinate but scientifically distinct realizations of the accepted totality requirement. Its totality claim depends on persistence of a previously verified sequence, not construction of an invariant set.

paper_level_methodology.working_title: Support-Aware Adaptive Decision-Sufficient Contact Operators for Constrained Normal-Tangential Impedance Control
paper_level_methodology.central_relation: (history, candidate impedance, support state) -> adaptive posterior plus currently valid margins -> constrained impedance decision -> total applied action
paper_level_methodology.contact_operator: z_k=E(h_k); p_Theta(o_k:k+H | z_k,a_k:k+H-1), with o containing force/tangent errors, contact/slip events, wrench, interaction energy and actuator load. paper_level_methodology.online_adaptation: Frozen nonlinear features phi(z,a) feed a low-dimensional Bayesian/RLS readout. Innovations update mean and covariance at every step; normalized-innovation persistence controls forgetting. An information-value term is enabled only when posterior uncertainty can change an active margin or action ranking, and its action must already satisfy the current authoritative margin relation.
paper_level_methodology.uncertainty_states: SUPPORTED uses population-calibrated F_cal. ADAPTING-IN-ENVELOPE uses F_adapt=F_env intersect F_veto, so membership always implies every independently valid envelope constraint; posterior belief may only add a veto or shape the objective. OUTSIDE-ENVELOPE returns the preverified constant-time withdrawal tuple u_wd inside a separately declared withdrawal envelope. Delayed non-overlapping residual auditing is required before calibrated re-entry.
paper_level_methodology.decision_objective: Minimize expected normal-force and tangential trajectory error, contact-loss/slip risk, gain variation and bounded decision-relevant information cost over a short horizon, subject to current-state wrench, contact/friction, energy, actuator and gain/rate margins.
analysis_scope: Decision-equivalence: operator-equivalent histories induce equivalent robust feasible sets and gain rankings up to declared distortion.
Conditional adaptation: bounded local drift plus persistent admissible excitation yields bounded readout error; decision recovery and calibration re-entry are distinct propositions.
Margin-state validity: each applied action is assessed only against M_cal or M_env whose applicability was decided pre-outcome.
Conditional totality is variant-specific and remains to be proven, not assumed achieved.

key_technical_risks: The physical envelope may be too conservative to retain informative actions.

Posterior propagation plus totality certification may exceed the update deadline.

For SUPPORTED pairs, the optimizer consumes calibrated one-sided margins M_cal. For ADAPTING-IN-ENVELOPE pairs define F_env={a:g_env,j(z,a,w)>=0 for every j and every w in W_env}. Then F_adapt=F_env intersect F_veto, with F_veto determined by posterior lower margins only when it is nonempty and contains the declared fallback; otherwise F_veto is the whole action set. Therefore F_adapt is always a subset of F_env. The posterior may add restrictions or shape cost/information value, but can never shrink W_env or relax any g_env constraint. Covariance inflation is never called coverage.

The frozen representation backbone feeds a low-dimensional Bayesian/RLS readout. Every observed outcome updates its mean and covariance; persistent normalized innovation increases forgetting and covariance. If uncertainty can change an active margin or gain ranking, the optimizer may choose an information-bearing impedance only from the current valid admissible relation.

Re-entry from ADAPTING-IN-ENVELOPE to SUPPORTED requires a delayed residual buffer not reused for the readout update, a predeclared effective sample size, a local-stationarity/dependence check and success of the empirical one-sided calibration audit. Until then the envelope relation remains authoritative even if posterior prediction or decision regret improves.

The horizon objective minimizes expected normal-force and tangential tracking loss, contact-loss/slip risk and gain variation, with a bounded information-value term only for decision-relevant uncertainty. It imposes the current-state margins on wrench, contact/friction, interaction energy, actuator effort and gain magnitude/rate.

OUTSIDE-ENVELOPE bypasses scan optimization in the same update and returns the preverified withdrawal tuple u_wd=(WITHDRAW,a_wd,r_wd): tangential reference speed goes to zero, gains move within rate bounds to a dissipative withdrawal setting, and the normal reference unloads along the last verified normal until the measured contact force is below the release threshold. u_wd is a constant-time lookup checked against robot-side wrench, energy, actuator and gain-rate bounds within the declared withdrawal envelope. No adaptation performance or arbitrary-shift safety claim is made in this branch.

Augment z_k with interaction-energy and gain-rate states. In SUPPORTED or ADAPTING scan mode compute a robust controlled-invariant inner set inside F_cal or F_adapt and keep a certified same-set backup. If the scan set is empty or the adaptation envelope is left, OUTSIDE-ENVELOPE has priority and returns u_wd by constant-time lookup.

target_intervention_novelty.uncovered_residual_delta: NNBO acts after trial-fixed scalar Hunt-Crossley identification and leaves abrupt/time-varying parameters open. MPVIC couples a probabilistic ensemble to uncertainty-seeking offline data acquisition and a separate deployment stiffness MPC in unconstrained free-space tasks; it does not establish continual soft-contact readout adaptation, state-dependent valid margins or admissible online information actions. The remaining Target delta is the adaptive decision-sufficient contact operator with explicit support-state semantics, constrained normal-tangential selection and a total applied-action relation.
target_intervention_novelty.mechanism_delta: At the causal position before gain selection, replace fixed scalar contact parameters with a history/action posterior; on pre-outcome support loss inside the envelope, switch margin authority from population calibration to an independently conservative envelope relation, adapt using only actions admissible under that relation, and require a delayed audit before calibrated re-entry.
target_intervention_novelty.scientific_delta: Determine whether this support-aware active contact adaptation recovers useful constrained normal-tangential impedance decisions under calibration-out changes, while preserving explicit failure boundaries and one total applied action.

candidate_principles.provisional_scientific_delta: A support-state-aware adaptive decision-sufficient contact operator that converts calibration-out soft-contact changes into constrained impedance decision recovery rather than detection or refusal, paired with one of two still-competing totality mechanisms. Variant B adds a same-relation invariant admissible set and certified backup rather than relying on shifted incumbent persistence.
candidate_principles.substantive_difference: Relative to NNBO, the modeled object, update timing and optimizer all change: fixed scalar material parameters become a history/action posterior over joint outcomes and margins; pre-identification becomes continual local adaptation with explicit margin-authority states; and unconstrained scalar optimal control becomes constrained belief-space selection of normal/tangential stiffness and damping. Incumbent and viability mechanisms remain subordinate but scientifically distinct realizations of the accepted totality requirement. Its totality claim depends on nonempty controlled invariance and backup successor membership, not retention of a prior optimizer result.

predictions.observable: Matched-compute held-out feasible-set agreement and impedance regret for scalar NNBO state, full physical features and the predictive state
predictions.pattern_a: The predictive state matches the high-information teacher within tolerance while scalar NNBO aliases histories and full reconstruction adds no decision value.
predictions.pattern_b: A calibrated memoryless or scalar contact state is decision-equivalent on the same shifts, margins and action class.
predictions.activation_condition: Held-out material, geometry, sliding or loading-history aliases occur.
predictions.killer_criterion: No reproducible feasible-set or impedance-decision advantage over the calibrated memoryless rival kills the representation delta.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Paired replay of identical histories and action probes isolates representation value before controller trials.

predictions.observable: After an in-envelope shift, posterior prediction error, feasible-action set and constrained impedance regret under passive update versus admissible decision-gated information actions
predictions.pattern_a: Both methods remain inside M_env, but recursive adaptation changes the posterior and feasible gains; admissible information actions shorten recovery of decision quality relative to passive adaptation and fixed conservative gains.
predictions.pattern_b: The posterior changes without recovering decision quality, or recovery requires inadmissible excitation, so the fixed conservative action is decision-equivalent or superior.
predictions.activation_condition: The shift changes active margins and at least one M_env-admissible informative action exists.
predictions.killer_criterion: Failure to recover decision quality inside the declared horizon despite admissible excitation, or any reliance on an action outside the active margin relation, kills active OOC handling.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Logged shift replay can compare estimates, active margins and decisions before physical scanning.

predictions.observable: State-labelled violations and sharpness under M_cal before shift, M_env during adaptation, and local M_cal after declared re-entry
predictions.pattern_a: Every adapting action lies in F_adapt and therefore in F_env; posterior belief only adds a veto or shapes the objective. Calibrated re-entry occurs only after the delayed audit. OUTSIDE-ENVELOPE returns u_wd before the deadline.
predictions.pattern_b: A calibrated memoryless relation meets the same validity and sharpness targets, an adapting action violates F_env because posterior belief relaxed it, or the outside-envelope branch lacks a timely feasible withdrawal action.
predictions.activation_condition: A supported pair becomes unsupported but stays in the physical envelope.
predictions.killer_criterion: Any adapting action outside F_env, unsupported calibrated re-entry, late/infeasible u_wd within the withdrawal envelope, or decision-equivalent calibrated-memoryless margins kills the corresponding relation claim.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Sequential residual replay directly separates decision recovery from margin applicability.

predictions.observable: Nonemptiness, recursive membership, backup availability and withdrawal latency under capacity motion, interruption and OUTSIDE-ENVELOPE activation
predictions.pattern_a: SUPPORTED/ADAPTING nominal and backup actions remain in a nonempty set inside F_cal/F_adapt; OUTSIDE-ENVELOPE returns feasible u_wd by constant-time lookup.
predictions.pattern_b: A useful invariant set cannot be certified or is too conservative, while a verified incumbent remains feasible and higher performing.
predictions.activation_condition: Capacity and energy/gain-rate margins evolve near a deadline.
predictions.killer_criterion: Empty scan set, uncertified successor/backup, any adapting action outside F_env, or any late/infeasible u_wd within the declared withdrawal envelope kills this branch.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Reachability and closed-loop set replay probes viability before hardware execution.

candidate_principles.status_rationale: Active R7 integrated Candidate B. It preserves the re-anchored adaptive contact core and incorporates the reviewed R5 viability mechanism as the causal repair for update-time totality.

paper_level_methodology.working_title: Support-Aware Adaptive Decision-Sufficient Contact Operators for Constrained Normal-Tangential Impedance Control
paper_level_methodology.central_relation: (history, candidate impedance, support state) -> adaptive posterior plus currently valid margins -> constrained impedance decision -> total applied action
paper_level_methodology.contact_operator: z_k=E(h_k); p_Theta(o_k:k+H | z_k,a_k:k+H-1), with o containing force/tangent errors, contact/slip events, wrench, interaction energy and actuator load. E and the outcome heads are trained by multistep likelihood plus feasible-set and decision-regret distortion, and pruned by decision equivalence.
paper_level_methodology.online_adaptation: Frozen nonlinear features phi(z,a) feed a low-dimensional Bayesian/RLS readout. Innovations update mean and covariance at every step; normalized-innovation persistence controls forgetting. An information-value term is enabled only when posterior uncertainty can change an active margin or action ranking, and its action must already satisfy the current authoritative margin relation.
paper_level_methodology.uncertainty_states: SUPPORTED uses population-calibrated F_cal. ADAPTING-IN-ENVELOPE uses F_adapt=F_env intersect F_veto, so membership always implies every independently valid envelope constraint; posterior belief may only add a veto or shape the objective. OUTSIDE-ENVELOPE returns the preverified constant-time withdrawal tuple u_wd inside a separately declared withdrawal envelope. Delayed non-overlapping residual auditing is required before calibrated re-entry.
paper_level_methodology.decision_objective: Minimize expected normal-force and tangential trajectory error, contact-loss/slip risk, gain variation and bounded decision-relevant information cost over a short horizon, subject to current-state wrench, contact/friction, energy, actuator and gain/rate margins.
analysis_scope: Decision-equivalence: operator-equivalent histories induce equivalent robust feasible sets and gain rankings up to declared distortion.
Conditional adaptation: bounded local drift plus persistent admissible excitation yields bounded readout error; decision recovery and calibration re-entry are distinct propositions.
Margin-state validity: each applied action is assessed only against M_cal or M_env whose applicability was decided pre-outcome.
Conditional totality is variant-specific and remains to be proven, not assumed achieved.
baseline_delta: fixed scalar Hunt-Crossley parameters -> history/action posterior over joint outcomes and margins
trial pre-identification -> continual local adaptation under explicit support states
unconstrained one-dimensional critic/HJB -> constrained short-horizon normal-tangential impedance selection
conditional nominal output -> total applied action via incumbent persistence or viability relation
paper_level_methodology.totality_renderer: Capacity-conditioned robust inner viability set with same-set certified backup action.

contributions.contribution: A decision-sufficient soft-contact operator trained and pruned by the constrained impedance decisions it must preserve.
contributions.advance: Changes the NNBO modeled object from fixed scalar material parameters to a minimal history/action posterior over joint contact outcomes and margins.
contributions.provenance: Formal migration of VES/SPO decision relevance; PSR and finite-area contact work are Evidence-informed derivations.

contributions.contribution: A three-state calibration-out adaptation semantics with an independently valid envelope relation during adaptation and a delayed audit for calibrated re-entry.
contributions.advance: Actually learns from new material, geometry, sliding and contact history while continuing bounded operation; separates decision recovery from coverage applicability.
contributions.provenance: Target-derived repair; conformal/split calibration supplies only bounded discipline, not a post-shift guarantee.

contributions.contribution: A posterior-aware constrained normal-tangential impedance problem in which information and task actions obey the same current-state physical margins.
contributions.advance: Explains why the new representation cannot feed NNBO unchanged: action-conditioned uncertainty and coupled outcomes require belief-space constrained selection.
contributions.provenance: MPVIC is only an Evidence-informed precedent for probabilistic model/action coupling; continual safe contact adaptation is not attributed to it.

contributions.contribution: A closed three-state applied-action relation that maps loss of the adaptation envelope to a preverified dissipative withdrawal impedance/reference action within the same deadline.
contributions.advance: Makes support loss an internal controller decision while preserving a strict claim boundary instead of delegating the actually applied action to an unspecified external policy.
contributions.provenance: Target-derived totality closure; no arbitrary-shift safety effect is attributed to a Source.

contributions.contribution: A capacity-conditioned viability relation whose nominal and backup impedance actions share the same support-state margins.
contributions.advance: Makes feasibility recursive under interruption rather than depending on a shifted incumbent.
contributions.provenance: R5 viability branch retained; safety/barrier literature supplies a conditional formal basis, not a transferred contact guarantee.

key_technical_risks: The physical envelope may be too conservative to retain informative actions.
Closed-loop dependence may prevent a defensible local calibration re-entry audit.
Frozen features may not span a genuinely novel contact regime.
Four gain coordinates may be too restrictive, while a richer matrix harms identifiability and timing.
Posterior propagation plus totality certification may exceed the update deadline.

causal_equivalence_mappings.causal_position: Contact representation and update before impedance optimization
causal_equivalence_mappings.direction: Source estimates one scalar fixed-trial Hunt-Crossley relation, then learns scalar optimal interaction under matched uncertainty; Target maps history and candidate normal-tangential impedance to posterior outcomes/margins and updates the readout during scanning.
causal_equivalence_mappings.activation_condition: Source assumes a bounded identified trial and does not activate on abrupt/time-varying parameters; Target activates on pre-outcome support loss or persistent innovation inside a declared envelope.
causal_equivalence_mappings.source_actual_effect: Online EWRLS identifies fixed contact parameters after excitation; a critic approximates the modified HJB and Newton inversion supplies reference position.
causal_equivalence_mappings.target_only_additions: Decision-sufficient representation, continual calibration-out adaptation, state-specific valid hard margins, safe information actions, coupled gains and deadline totality.

causal_equivalence_mappings.causal_position: Probabilistic dynamics learning, information acquisition and deployment impedance MPC
causal_equivalence_mappings.direction: Source uses an ensemble and uncertainty-seeking CEM to collect offline data, followed by separate deployment CEM stiffness planning; Target performs continual low-dimensional contact readout updates and allows information value only inside the active admissible margin relation.
causal_equivalence_mappings.activation_condition: Source exploration is a training/data-collection phase for free-space task transfer; Target adaptation activates during continuous contact when support or innovations indicate a decision-relevant shift.
causal_equivalence_mappings.source_actual_effect: Improved sample-efficient learning and planned variable stiffness in reported unconstrained tasks.
causal_equivalence_mappings.target_only_additions: Finite-area/history-aware outcomes, normal-tangential impedance, nonlinear wrench/contact/energy constraints, local calibration re-entry and total rendering.
